sentences.text: In its 2025-2026 report, Remembrance Parks Central Victoria described its burial, cremation and memorialisation services and care of 12 remembrance parks.
The trust reported introducing new burial products and sections and improving cemetery records through its PlotBox management system.
sentences.section: Report from the Trust Chair & Chief Executive Officer

sentences.text: It reported that management of Heathcote Cemetery transferred to the trust in February 2026 and that its cremator replacement project reached the tender-ready stage.
sentences.section: Report from the Trust Chair & Chief Executive Officer

sentences.text: The trust reported receiving Department of Health structural support funding in June 2026 to help maintain financial sustainability after prolonged financial pressures.
sentences.section: Report from the Trust Chair & Chief Executive Officer

items.quote: This funding has stabilised cashflow and enabled RPCV to continue working on improvements to financial position.
